added.name: Riften
added.long_description:
Riften builds earned intelligence: models that come out of a company’s own work instead of out of a lab.

One environment variable points an existing application at Riften instead of OpenAI or Anthropic. Riften routes each request to the least expensive model likely to handle it, using open-weight models we host whenever they are sufficient. Customers lower inference costs before any training begins.

Because Riften sits in the request path, real tasks and their outcomes create training evidence the company controls. Riften uses that evidence to improve routing and train private models on open weights around recurring work. Those models earn production traffic by meeting the same bar as the APIs they replace.

Over time, frontier APIs handle only the tasks that still require them. The rest runs on models the company owns, on infrastructure it controls, inside the applications where the work happens.

Dench: AI CRM + Full-Service Deployment

Most CRMs sell you software and hand you a 200-page setup guide. Dench is different. We're the only CRM that ships with an embedded team: we migrate your data, build your object schema, configure your integrations, train your people, and deploy AI agents that keep your pipeline clean without a Salesforce developer, a RevOps contractor, or a six-month implementation project.

From day one, our team works inside your stack. We pull your existing data out of HubSpot, Salesforce, or whatever spreadsheet graveyard you're currently using, and rebuild it properly in Dench. Custom objects, custom fields, automation rules, integration config across Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, LinkedIn, and 50+ other tools. Everything set up the way your business actually works, not the way a generic CRM template assumes it does.

Then we train your team. Not a one-hour Zoom and a PDF. Real sessions that build CRM discipline: how to log activity consistently, how to keep data clean, how to use AI agents to do the repetitive work so your reps spend time selling instead of updating fields. Quarterly business reviews keep the system evolving as your pipeline grows.

The AI layer is what makes it permanent. Dench agents enrich leads automatically, move deals through stages based on real signals, draft outreach, log interactions, and flag hygiene issues before they compound. Your CRM stays accurate without someone babysitting it.

No implementation consultant invoice. No dedicated Salesforce admin headcount. No duct-taped automation stack. One engagement, everything included, starting at $1,500/month.

long_description.before:
We’re archiving the physical world for embodied intelligence by collecting and labeling aligned multimodal data. To build dexterous and perceptive robots that generalize robustly, we need massive amounts of real-world data across multiple modalities and environments.

We have thought deeply about the fine line between biomimicry and its application to humanoid systems. Based on this research, we design and deploy custom hardware across residential and manufacturing settings. We then post-process the resulting data through internal QA, anonymization, and annotation pipelines to deliver diverse, high-fidelity datasets at scale to frontier labs developing robotics foundation models and general-purpose robotics companies. 

We believe we are at a historic inflection point, with a unique opportunity to leave a dent on humanity and reshape physical labor markets forever. That's why our team dropped out of Stanford and Berkeley and moved to Asia to collect the world’s largest annotated multimodal dataset.
long_description.after:
Human Archive (YC W26) is building the data infrastructure for physical AI.

We design hardware, deploy cameras and sensors globally, and train models that help AI better understand how humans interact with the physical world.

Leading frontier AI labs trust us for their video, sensor, robot deployment, image, and audio datasets.

We have offices in SF, China, and India and are researchers from NYU GRAIL, UPenn GRASP, UC Berkeley, Stanford, Johns Hopkins Robotics, and national robotics champions.

To get data, please reach out to raj@humanarchive.ai

one_liner.before: Multimodal data provider for robotics and world modeling

long_description.before:
Rindler turns any website, including sites without APIs, into a deterministic API that AI agents can reliably use. It handles logins, 2FA, and bot detection, giving agents clean structured data and dependable actions instead of raw HTML, with robust maintenance when sites change.

Rindler is agent-agnostic and built on the open MCP standard, so it works with any agent.

For operators: get your team out of portals and back to the work that matters.

For agent builders: let your agents act on the real web quickly, cheaply, and reliably on every run.
long_description.after:
Rindler turns any website into deterministic abstractions that AI agents can operate on with speed, efficiency, and reliability.

Rindler drives a real browser to execute tasks on websites. It signs in, handles one-time verification codes, navigates to the right screen, retrieves records or completes forms, and returns structured output in a caller-defined schema.

Most browser agents re-process and re-compute the same website every time they visit it. Rindler remembers. Our infrastructure gets faster and cheaper the more it is used, and when a site changes underneath it, Rindler detects the break and heals itself.

For operations leaders, Rindler takes on the repetitive website work your team does by hand, giving them their time back for the work that matters.

For agent builders, Rindler is a single endpoint that carries out tasks on the web, so you do not have to build or run browser infrastructure of your own.

long_description.before: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in a sealed box. The box sits at the site it protects (data centers, power grid, airports, bases) with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard visual navigation that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $50k threats; our interceptors cost like the threat and launches scale with the swarm. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles: hardware, reloads, and monitoring included. Air defense as a Service.
